group.passage: Hummingbirds are among the smallest birds in the world, and they can do something that few other birds can. Text A explains how they stay in one place in the air, and Text B comes from the notebook of a traveler who loves birds.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Little Helicopters
passage_parts.text: Most birds move their wings up and down. A hummingbird does something different. Its wings sweep forward and back in the shape of a figure eight, and they beat dozens of times every second. This lets the bird hover, or stay in one place in the air, for a long time. It can even fly backward. Hovering burns a huge amount of energy, so these birds need plenty of sweet food. Their main food is nectar, a sweet liquid inside flowers. While a hummingbird drinks, pollen sticks to its head and bill. When it visits the next flower, it carries the pollen along, and this helps the plant make seeds. Many flowers that depend on these birds are red and shaped like long tubes. They have no place for insects to land, but a bird that can hover does not need one. Hummingbirds are found only in the Americas.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: From a Bird Lover’s Notebook
passage_parts.text: Day one: Our guide hung a small bottle of sugar water outside the hotel. Within minutes, a tiny green bird arrived. It hung in the air in front of the bottle and drank without landing. Its wings moved so fast that they were just a blur, and they made a soft humming sound. So that’s where the name comes from! Day two: Along the garden path, I watched one of these birds visit one red flower after another. By noon, the top of its head was yellow with pollen. I tried to take photos, but it was always faster than my camera. Day three: Early this morning, a little bird sat on a branch near my window. It didn’t move, even when I came close. I was afraid it was sick, but our guide said it was just in a deep sleep. On cold nights, these birds sleep this way to save energy, and they slowly warm up again in the morning.

translation_zh.text:
【引言】蜂鳥是世界上最小的鳥類之一，而且牠們會做一件很少有其他鳥做得到的事。Text A 說明牠們怎麼停在半空中的同一個位置，Text B 摘自一位愛鳥旅人的筆記。
【A 小小直升機】大部分的鳥是上下拍動翅膀，蜂鳥卻不一樣。牠的翅膀前後擺動，劃出「8」字形，每秒拍動好幾十下。這讓牠能夠盤旋，也就是在空中同一個位置停很久。牠甚至可以往後飛。盤旋會消耗大量能量，所以蜂鳥需要大量甜的食物。牠們主要的食物是花蜜，也就是花朵裡甜甜的汁液。蜂鳥吸食花蜜時，花粉會黏在牠的頭和喙上。牠飛到下一朵花時，就把花粉一起帶過去，幫助植物結出種子。很多靠蜂鳥傳粉的花是紅色的，形狀像長長的管子。這些花沒有讓昆蟲降落的地方，但會盤旋的鳥根本不需要。蜂鳥只分布在美洲。
【B 愛鳥人的筆記】第一天：導遊在旅館外掛了一小瓶糖水。不到幾分鐘，一隻小小的綠色鳥兒就來了。牠停在瓶子前的半空中，沒有落腳就喝了起來。牠的翅膀動得好快，只看得到一片模糊，還發出輕柔的嗡嗡聲。原來名字就是這麼來的！第二天：沿著花園小徑，我看著一隻蜂鳥一朵接一朵地造訪紅花。到了中午，牠的頭頂已經沾滿黃色的花粉。我想拍照，可是牠總是比我的相機快。第三天：今天一大早，一隻小鳥停在我窗邊的樹枝上。我走近了，牠還是一動也不動。我擔心牠生病了，但導遊說牠只是在沉睡。寒冷的夜裡，蜂鳥會用這種方式睡覺來節省能量，到了早上再慢慢暖和起來。
